_comment: The ONLY vocabulary reporting.py may emit. Spec section 12.5: the report
generator receives structured evidence, not raw untrusted text, and 'must
not invent detected tools, completed steps, customer reviews, or safety
outcomes'. Every user-visible sentence in an assessment comes from this
file, with placeholders filled only from values that exist in the evidence.
kind drives which section of the spec section 12.5 report it lands in.
Customer-facing phrasing follows spec section 2: no model names, no raw
confidence percentages, no implication of a legal certification.

ALL_REQUIRED_TOOLS_VISIBLE.text: All required tools for this trade were visible in the submission.

TASK_STEPS_COMPLETED.text: Every step of the guided task was completed: {steps}.

SAFETY_STEPS_OBSERVED.text: The expected safety practices were observed during the task.

MEDIA_QUALITY_GOOD.text: The recording was clear enough to review confidently.

IDENTITY_TOKEN_VERIFIED.text: The on-screen verification code matched, supporting a live capture.

KNOWLEDGE_CHECK_STRONG.text: The knowledge check was answered well.

MISSING_REQUIRED_TOOL.text: These required tools were not clearly visible: {tools}. Show each one on camera before starting.

TOKEN_MISMATCH.text: The on-screen verification code did not match the one issued for this submission. Please record again with the current code visible.

TOKEN_UNREADABLE.text: The verification code could not be read. Hold it steady and closer to the camera, in good light.

LOW_MEDIA_QUALITY.text: The recording was too unclear to review reliably. Record again in better light, holding the camera steady.

VIDEO_TOO_SHORT.text: The recording was shorter than the minimum required for review.

NO_PERSON_DETECTED.text: No person was visible for most of the recording. Make sure you and your hands stay in frame.

DUPLICATE_MEDIA.text: This recording closely matches one submitted earlier. Please record a new attempt.

SCENE_DISCONTINUITY.text: The recording appears to contain cuts. Please submit one continuous take.

METADATA_INCONSISTENT.text: The recording details were inconsistent and need a second look.

SAFETY_REVIEW_REQUIRED.text: One or more safety practices need review before this task can be marked complete.

PRACTICAL_TASK_NOT_PASSED.text: The guided task was not completed to the expected standard. These steps were not evidenced: {steps}.

LOW_KNOWLEDGE_SCORE.text: The knowledge check score was low. This does not by itself affect the practical result.

RESUBMIT_IDENTITY.text: Identity evidence was incomplete. Please complete identity verification and submit again.

LOW_EVIDENCE_COVERAGE.text: Not enough evidence was available to reach a conclusion. Missing: {missing}.

LIMIT_SINGLE_TASK.text: This review evaluates one guided task and does not guarantee performance on every job.

LIMIT_NOT_A_LICENCE.text: This is not a licence or a legally recognised trade certification.

LIMIT_TOOLS_ARE_NOT_SKILL.text: Visible tools show what was present on camera, not ownership or correct use.

LIMIT_CONFIG_NOT_EXPERT_REVIEWED.text: The rubric for this trade has not yet been reviewed by a qualified trade expert.

LIMIT_HEURISTIC_ADAPTERS.text: Evidence was produced by prototype quality checks, not validated detection models.

LIMIT_UNCALIBRATED_SCORE.text: The score reflects available evidence only and has not been calibrated against real outcomes.

TRADE_NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_DB.text: This trade is not present in the platform's trade list, so the result was not filed against a worker record.

NO_VIDEO_TRADETEST_FOR_TRADE.text: No video assessment exists for this trade, so the result could not be filed.

AMBIGUOUS_VIDEO_TRADETEST.text: More than one video assessment matched this trade, so the result was not filed.

SCHEMA_DRIFT_TABLE_MISSING.text: The assessment was completed but could not be filed because the target table is unavailable.

WRITEBACK_POLICY_WITHHELD_SCORE.text: The assessment was filed without a numeric score, as configured.
